answer.summary: Two ArchUnit architecture tests fail deterministically (TenantActiveTableAccessArchTest, 2 failures out of 106). The change added new direct repository/entity access from payload code: PayloadCustomizationService calls InjectorContract.getAttackPatterns() and PayloadCustomizationMerge and PayloadLocalVersioning call PayloadIdentity methods. Those classes are outside the allowed package list, so re-running will fail the same way. The change needs to route those calls through the allowed services or update the rule with review.
